correctness.rationale: Every endomorphism is freely specified by square-zero images of generators. In odd characteristic the square-zero annihilator recursion, with a complete rank stratification in A3, proves the S4 polynomial. The monomial cotangent argument with invertible unit factors proves the Aut formula. In characteristic two Frobenius and Nakayama give the End and Aut formulas. Direct finite enumerations of A3 over fields of sizes 3 and 5 and A4 over size 2 are corroborating checks, not the proof.

value.rationale: A complete count of all endomorphisms is a natural invariant of the canonical r-fold tensor product of the dual-number algebra. Rank four is the first threshold in ranks <=4 where the odd-characteristic density tends to zero as field size grows, because genuinely interacting quadratic supports appear. The characteristic-two density instead approaches one, a substantive and structurally explained exact dichotomy. It is a complete first-transition fact, not an arbitrary field-specific numerical sample.
